result.summary: Found 2 minor visual issues regarding icon rendering and text truncation.

issues.description: Top-right action button displays as an empty circle with a red notification dot.
issues.suggestion: Include an appropriate icon inside the container and align the status badge.

issues.description: Restaurant title in the horizontal card list is abruptly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Enable two-line text wrapping or adjust card width to accommodate longer names.
